en: The image shows a colorized view of a small village with traditional German houses, a grassy area in the foreground, and a church tower visible in the background. There are several trees lining a street, and horse-drawn carriages can be seen. The scene is tranquil, likely from an early 20th-century rural German settlement. The postcard has elegant red script text at the bottom.
